measures.name: Average Order Value
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Paid Revenue (Products)], [Paid Orders (Products)] )
measures.description: Paid revenue excl. VAT ÷ paid orders (paid date).

measures.name: Paid Revenue PP
measures.expression:
VAR _first = MIN ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] )
VAR _last = MAX ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] )
VAR _days = INT ( _last - _first ) + 1
RETURN
    CALCULATE (
        [Paid Revenue (Products)],
        REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Calendar' ),
        FILTER (
            ALL ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] ),
            'Calendar'[Date (format)] >= _first - _days
                && 'Calendar'[Date (format)] <= _first - 1
        )
    )
measures.description: Paid revenue for the prior period of equal length immediately before the selected dates.

measures.name: Paid Orders PP
measures.expression:
VAR _first = MIN ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] )
VAR _last = MAX ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] )
VAR _days = INT ( _last - _first ) + 1
RETURN
    CALCULATE (
        [Paid Orders (Products)],
        REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Calendar' ),
        FILTER (
            ALL ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] ),
            'Calendar'[Date (format)] >= _first - _days
                && 'Calendar'[Date (format)] <= _first - 1
        )
    )
measures.description: Paid orders, prior period of equal length.

measures.name: Average Order Value PP
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Paid Revenue PP], [Paid Orders PP] )
measures.description: AOV for the prior period of equal length.

measures.name: Paid Revenue Δ%
measures.expression: VAR _p = [Paid Revenue PP] RETURN IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( _p ), DIVIDE ( [Paid Revenue (Products)] - _p, _p ) )
measures.description: Change in paid revenue vs the prior period of equal length.

measures.name: Paid Revenue LY
measures.expression:
VAR _first = MIN ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] )
VAR _last = MAX ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] )
VAR _days = INT ( _last - _first ) + 1
RETURN
    CALCULATE (
        [Paid Revenue (Products)],
        REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Calendar' ),
        FILTER (
            ALL ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] ),
            'Calendar'[Date (format)] >= EDATE ( _first, -12 )
                && 'Calendar'[Date (format)] <= EDATE ( _last, -12 )
        )
    )
measures.description: Paid revenue for the same dates one year earlier. Blank before Jul 2026 (orders data starts Jul 2025).

measures.name: KPI Revenue Δ
measures.expression:
VAR _c = [Paid Revenue (Products)]
VAR _p = [Paid Revenue PP]
VAR _first = MIN ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] )
VAR _last = MAX ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] )
VAR _days = INT ( _last - _first ) + 1
RETURN
    IF (
        ISBLANK ( _p ) || _p = 0,
        "No prior-period data",
        VAR _d = DIVIDE ( _c - _p, _p )
        RETURN IF ( _d >= 0, "▲ ", "▼ " ) & FORMAT ( ABS ( _d ), "0.0%" ) & " vs prior " & _days & " days"
    )
measures.description: Card caption.

measures.name: KPI Orders Δ
measures.expression:
VAR _c = [Paid Orders (Products)]
VAR _p = [Paid Orders PP]
VAR _first = MIN ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] )
VAR _last = MAX ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] )
VAR _days = INT ( _last - _first ) + 1
RETURN
    IF (
        ISBLANK ( _p ) || _p = 0,
        "No prior-period data",
        VAR _d = DIVIDE ( _c - _p, _p )
        RETURN IF ( _d >= 0, "▲ ", "▼ " ) & FORMAT ( ABS ( _d ), "0.0%" ) & " vs prior " & _days & " days"
    )
measures.description: Card caption.

measures.name: KPI AOV Δ
measures.expression:
VAR _c = [Average Order Value]
VAR _p = [Average Order Value PP]
VAR _first = MIN ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] )
VAR _last = MAX ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] )
VAR _days = INT ( _last - _first ) + 1
RETURN
    IF (
        ISBLANK ( _p ) || _p = 0,
        "No prior-period data",
        VAR _d = DIVIDE ( _c - _p, _p )
        RETURN IF ( _d >= 0, "▲ ", "▼ " ) & FORMAT ( ABS ( _d ), "0.0%" ) & " vs prior " & _days & " days"
    )
measures.description: Card caption.

measures.name: KPI Revenue Δ Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _c = [Paid Revenue (Products)]
VAR _p = [Paid Revenue PP]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _p ) || _c >= _p, "#00845F", "#E5484D" )
measures.description: Green up / red down.

measures.name: KPI Orders Δ Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _c = [Paid Orders (Products)]
VAR _p = [Paid Orders PP]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _p ) || _c >= _p, "#00845F", "#E5484D" )
measures.description: Green up / red down.

measures.name: KPI AOV Δ Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _c = [Average Order Value]
VAR _p = [Average Order Value PP]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _p ) || _c >= _p, "#00845F", "#E5484D" )
measures.description: Green up / red down.

measures.name: New Customer Revenue
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( [Paid Revenue (Products)], KEEPFILTERS ( revenue_orders_tbl[type_of_customer] = "New Customer" ) )
measures.description: Paid revenue from clients who signed up on the order day.

measures.name: New Customer Share
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [New Customer Revenue], [Paid Revenue (Products)] )
measures.description: Share of paid revenue from new customers (Excel: New Revenue %).

measures.name: New Customer Share PP
measures.expression:
VAR _first = MIN ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] )
VAR _last = MAX ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] )
VAR _days = INT ( _last - _first ) + 1
RETURN
    CALCULATE (
        DIVIDE ( [New Customer Revenue], [Paid Revenue (Products)] ),
        REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Calendar' ),
        FILTER (
            ALL ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] ),
            'Calendar'[Date (format)] >= _first - _days
                && 'Calendar'[Date (format)] <= _first - 1
        )
    )
measures.description: New-customer share, prior period of equal length.

measures.name: KPI New Share Δ
measures.expression:
VAR _c = [New Customer Share]
VAR _p = [New Customer Share PP]
VAR _d = ( _c - _p ) * 100
VAR _first = MIN ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] )
VAR _last = MAX ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] )
VAR _days = INT ( _last - _first ) + 1
RETURN
    IF (
        ISBLANK ( _p ) || ISBLANK ( _c ),
        "No prior-period data",
        IF ( _d >= 0, "▲ ", "▼ " ) & FORMAT ( ABS ( _d ), "0.0" ) & " pts vs prior " & _days & " days"
    )
measures.description: Card caption.

measures.name: KPI New Share Δ Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _c = [New Customer Share]
VAR _p = [New Customer Share PP]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _p ) || _c >= _p, "#00845F", "#E5484D" )
measures.description: Green up / red down.

measures.name: Open Unpaid Revenue
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( [Unpaid Revenue (Products)], KEEPFILTERS ( revenue_orders_tbl[Status_Filter] IN { "Unpaid", "Payment Pending", "Collections", "Draft" } ) )
measures.description: Invoice value excl. VAT still collectable (Unpaid, Payment Pending, Collections, Draft), by order date. Filters Status_Filter because the base measure overrides invoice_status.

measures.name: Open Unpaid Orders
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( [Unpaid Orders (Products)], KEEPFILTERS ( revenue_orders_tbl[Status_Filter] IN { "Unpaid", "Payment Pending", "Collections", "Draft" } ) )
measures.description: Orders whose invoice is still collectable.

measures.name: Cancelled Revenue
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( [Unpaid Revenue (Products)], KEEPFILTERS ( revenue_orders_tbl[Status_Filter] = "Cancelled" ) )
measures.description: Invoice value excl. VAT on cancelled invoices (lost), by order date.

measures.name: Cancelled Orders
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( [Unpaid Orders (Products)], KEEPFILTERS ( revenue_orders_tbl[Status_Filter] = "Cancelled" ) )
measures.description: Orders whose invoice was cancelled.

measures.name: KPI Unpaid Caption
measures.expression: VAR _n = [Open Unpaid Orders] RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _n ), "No open invoices", FORMAT ( _n, "#,0" ) & " orders awaiting payment" )
measures.description: Card caption.

measures.name: KPI Cancelled Caption
measures.expression: VAR _n = [Cancelled Orders] RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _n ), "No cancelled invoices", FORMAT ( _n, "#,0" ) & " orders cancelled" )
measures.description: Card caption.

measures.name: Invoiced Value
measures.expression: [RO Invoice Total]
measures.description: All invoices excl. VAT, each once, by order date (Excel: 'Power BI new revenue').

measures.name: Paid Share of Invoiced
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( [RO Invoice Total], revenue_orders_tbl[invoice_status] = "Paid" ), [RO Invoice Total] )
measures.description: Share of invoiced value (orders placed in the period) that is paid. Excel: Paid tracker '% Paid'.

measures.name: App Sales Revenue
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( [Paid Revenue (Products)], KEEPFILTERS ( revenue_orders_tbl[Sales Channel] = "App" ) )
measures.description: Paid revenue from app sales (signup_agent = App Sale).

measures.name: App Sales Share
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [App Sales Revenue], [Paid Revenue (Products)] )
measures.description: Share of paid revenue from app sales.

measures.name: Local Domain Revenue
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( [Paid Revenue (Products)], KEEPFILTERS ( revenue_orders_tbl[Sub Category] = "Domains" ), KEEPFILTERS ( revenue_orders_tbl[Domain Region] = "Local" ) )
measures.description: Paid domain-registration revenue for local TLDs (.co.za, .africa …).

measures.name: International Domain Revenue
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( [Paid Revenue (Products)], KEEPFILTERS ( revenue_orders_tbl[Sub Category] = "Domains" ), KEEPFILTERS ( revenue_orders_tbl[Domain Region] = "International" ) )
measures.description: Paid domain-registration revenue for international TLDs.

measures.name: Domains Added
measures.expression:
VAR _dates = VALUES ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] )
RETURN
    CALCULATE (
        DISTINCTCOUNT ( revenue_orders_tbl[service_id] ),
        revenue_orders_tbl[invoice_status] = "Paid",
        KEEPFILTERS ( revenue_orders_tbl[Sub Category] = "Domains" ),
        REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Calendar' ),
        TREATAS ( _dates, revenue_orders_tbl[Revenue Date] )
    )
measures.description: Domain registrations/transfers on paid orders, by paid date.

measures.name: Local Domains Added
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( [Domains Added], KEEPFILTERS ( revenue_orders_tbl[Domain Region] = "Local" ) )
measures.description: Excel: No. of Local Domains Added (paid orders only).

measures.name: International Domains Added
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( [Domains Added], KEEPFILTERS ( revenue_orders_tbl[Domain Region] = "International" ) )
measures.description: Excel: No. of Int. Domains Added (paid orders only).

measures.name: Services Sold
measures.expression:
VAR _dates = VALUES ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] )
RETURN
    CALCULATE (
        DISTINCTCOUNT ( revenue_orders_tbl[service_id] ),
        revenue_orders_tbl[invoice_status] = "Paid",
        REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Calendar' ),
        TREATAS ( _dates, revenue_orders_tbl[Revenue Date] )
    )
measures.description: Services/domains on paid orders, by paid date. Split by service_status to see how many are still active.

measures.name: Revenue % of Total
measures.expression:
DIVIDE (
    [Paid Revenue (Products)],
    CALCULATE (
        [Paid Revenue (Products)],
        ALLSELECTED ( revenue_orders_tbl[Category], revenue_orders_tbl[Sub Category], revenue_orders_tbl[Product Name] )
    )
)
measures.description: Share of the selected total, for the product matrix.

measures.name: Period Label
measures.expression:
VAR _first = MIN ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] )
VAR _last = MAX ( 'Calendar'[Date (format)] )
RETURN FORMAT ( _first, "d mmm yyyy" ) & " – " & FORMAT ( _last, "d mmm yyyy" )
measures.description: Selected period.

measures.name: Data As Of
measures.expression:
VAR _d = CALCULATE ( MAX ( orders_invoices_tbl[order_date] ), REMOVEFILTERS () )
RETURN "Data to " & FORMAT ( _d, "d mmm yyyy" )
measures.description: Latest order date in the model.

measures.name: Overview Insight
measures.expression:
VAR _rev = [Paid Revenue (Products)]
VAR _ord = [Paid Orders (Products)]
VAR _d = [Paid Revenue Δ%]
VAR _top =
    TOPN ( 1, ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( revenue_orders_tbl[Category] ), "@r", [Paid Revenue (Products)] ), [@r], DESC )
VAR _topName = MAXX ( _top, revenue_orders_tbl[Category] )
VAR _topShare = DIVIDE ( MAXX ( _top, [@r] ), _rev )
VAR _new = [New Customer Share]
RETURN
    IF (
        ISBLANK ( _rev ),
        "No paid sales in the selected period.",
        "Paid revenue R " & FORMAT ( _rev, "#,0" ) & " from " & FORMAT ( _ord, "#,0" ) & " orders"
            & IF ( ISBLANK ( _d ), "", " (" & IF ( _d >= 0, "▲ ", "▼ " ) & FORMAT ( ABS ( _d ), "0.0%" ) & " vs prior period)" )
            & ". " & _topName & " brought " & FORMAT ( _topShare, "0%" ) & " of it; new customers "
            & FORMAT ( _new, "0%" ) & "; app sales " & FORMAT ( [App Sales Share], "0%" ) & "."
    )
measures.description: One-sentence summary for the Overview page.
